narrative.northStar: The Window Left Open on a Winter Night
narrative.overview: Direction D is binding: a real 3D map, darkness as the canvas and warm candle light as the only bright thing. The advent calendar is carried by the little door with a day number. By day a pale winter map; at sunset in Prague the map darkens, the doors open and the windows glow. Zooming out is continuous to the globe.
keyCharacteristics: A real 3D map, not an illustration.
Warm light means a window of an advent calendar, and nothing else is warm.
The day number lives on the door, never in a sentence.
Day and night switch by the sun in Prague, never by the system theme.
One continuous zoom from a doorstep to the globe.

rules.name: The One Warm Light Rule
rules.body: Warm hues mark advent windows only.

rules.name: The Sky Clock Rule
rules.body: The palette is chosen by duskAt, the sunset in Prague for the date.

rules.name: The Dusk Event Rule
rules.body: Day mixes into night over 3.2 s while the doors open and glow fades in.

rules.name: The No Counting Rule
rules.body: No window numbers, countdowns or lighting times as text.

rules.name: The Glass Has A Reason Rule
rules.body: Frosted sheets keep the map readable under controls; no other glass.

dos: Do keep the night palette exactly as approved; day is a second palette, not a reinterpretation.
Do put the day number on the door and in the strip, and nowhere in a sentence.
Do switch day and night only at duskAt, the sunset in Prague, and animate it as one event.
Do keep zooming continuous down to the globe, and keep panning free.
Do respect reduced motion: no door swing, no breathing pool, instant dusk, camera jumps instead of flights.
Do keep touch targets at least 44 px and text at least 4.5:1 on both palettes.
donts: Don't show lighting times, "zhasne", countdowns or window numbers as text.
Don't use warm colour for anything that is not an advent window.
Don't add Santa, clip art stars, red and green, snowflake emoji or falling snow; winter shows as frost on shut doors and a pale snowy day map.
Don't return to the illustrative looks of A, B and C, or to Geist, Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, DM Sans or Space Grotesk.
Don't let neighbouring countries go pitch black; they sit under a light veil so the zoom out stays one move.
